rationale: The agent verified the user by matching the provided email to a single account, then used read-only tools to inspect orders before acting. The user explicitly confirmed they wanted to return all items from both orders, satisfying the requirement to confirm before an order-changing write. The agent then correctly submitted return requests for all delivered items on both orders, with refunds to the original payment methods. When the user later requested cross-refunding to the opposite payment methods, the agent correctly declined as not permitted by policy and provided accurate reasoning. Final information about the return status and refund timeline was consistent with tool outputs. No unsupported claims, unauthorized actions, or missed confirmations were observed.
